newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia fastest growing area for Australia's Colonial.
newsitem.headline: Asia fastest growing area for Australia's Colonial.

text.p: Australia's Colonial Mutual Group said on Thursday that its joint venture insurance businesses in Asia were the fastest growing sector of its international operations.

"Last year, Asia accounted for more than 17 percent of our total life annual premium income and the forecast for this year is better again," chief executive and managing director Peter Smedley said in a speech in Hong Kong.
"Our new business growth in the region has been steady and strong -- 26 percent in 1995 and 49 percent so far this year."
By way of comparison, Colonial's business overall had grown about 20 percent so far this year, he said later.
Colonial entered Asia in 1990 through a joint venture with Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd unit Jardine Pacific now operating in Hong Kong, the Philipines and Singapore.
Since then it forged joint ventures with the Astra group in Indonesia, the Bank of Ayudhya group in Thailand, and Edaran Otomobil Nasional in Malaysia.
Colonial also had two representative offices in China and was awaiting an invitation to apply for a licence. Longer term, it was also looking at India and Vietnam, Smedley said.
